description: Use this when the user asks for the finished SVG file itself, to save or use it. It never spends a credit. If the person has already unlocked this image, in the VecSnap card or on their VecSnap page, it answers download_url, a link that downloads the file for an hour (for the person or a program). If not, download_url is null and page_url is the person's way to unlock it, for one credit.
name: get_svg
title: Get the SVG file
